Subscribe to Pro for $10/month with $10 of credits, or Scale for $29.99/month with $30 of credits, per paid billing period, then buy additional credits as needed, and set a monthly spend cap in Settings if you want one. Unused plan credits expire. Upgrading from Pro to Scale starts a new billing period with a credit for unused Pro time; switching back takes effect at once. Usage credits & billing details

The limits above are capacity limits per project; where a paid plan has none, it pays for what it uses. Compute, storage, backups, auth users above the free allowance, and on paid plans database and app disk, email and background job time above their allowances draw from usage credits at the published rates. The Free plan has no monthly subscription fee; usage still consumes credits. Subscribe to Pro for $10/month with $10 of credits, or Scale for $29.99/month with $30 of credits, per paid billing period, then buy additional credits as needed, and set a monthly spend cap in Settings if you want one. Unused plan credits expire. Upgrading from Pro to Scale starts a new billing period with a credit for unused Pro time; switching back takes effect at once. An active paid subscription is required to buy more credits. Manage, change or cancel your subscription from Credits & Billing.
